baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative opening predicates the paired plural khayrat and hisan of an interior plurality.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first noun supplies desirable benefit and the adjective adds perceptible goodness or beauty, so utility and attractiveness reinforce one another without becoming identical.

activation_trace.role: Desirable, beneficial good supplies the focus noun's useful-content pole.
Goodness or beauty opposed to ugliness supplies the qualifying pole of pleasing fitness.

changed_reading.before: The clause merely reports that good things are there.
changed_reading.after: The interiors hold plural benefits whose desirability is completed by a distinct quality of beauty or fittingness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feminine plural noun-adjective pair can denote bearers of excellence as well as impersonal goods.
baseline_models.mechanism: Choice excellence can characterize people or things, while the beauty branch readily characterizes persons; this activates excellent beautiful female beings without making that the only grammatical option.

activation_trace.role: Virtue, soundness, and chosen excellence make persons or person-like bearers available.
Personal or objective beauty supplies the visible qualification of those excellent bearers.

changed_reading.before: Khayrat is an inventory of unspecified good objects.
changed_reading.after: Choice, sound, beautiful feminine persons are a live referent, alongside the still-live reading of excellent things or qualities.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus roots have branches of giving or doing good, allowing the plurals to name effects and acts rather than static ornaments.
baseline_models.mechanism: Generous gift and skillful beneficent action combine into plural beneficences: good is something bestowed and beautifully enacted.

activation_trace.role: Generosity and gift turn the focus noun from possessed quality into bestowed benefit.
Beneficent or skillful good action makes beauty functional and relational.

changed_reading.after: It can also praise plural gifts, good deeds, or beneficent capacities whose goodness is realized in action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation as completed form, measured balance, and nurturing completion make the focus excellence look produced and matured rather than merely labeled.

activation_trace.role: Chosen soundness supplies the quality that the contextual processes bring to completion.
Beauty or goodness supplies the manifested result of proportion and cultivation.
Complete formation and balanced shape supply a production process for the focus beauty.
A created thing made in equilibrium turns beauty into proportioned fitness.
Repair, nurture, and completion make excellence the outcome of sustained cultivation.

structural_cues: The surah moves from creation and balance into cultivated garden interiors before the focus clause.
The focus couples an excellence noun to a beauty adjective rather than repeating one undifferentiated praise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies complete formation, equilibrium, and nurturing completion; I infer that these processes produce the focus excellence, while a simple inventory of already-complete persons or goods remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The beautiful excellences simply exist as fixed endowments.
changed_reading.after: They are excellences brought to full, balanced form, whether cultivated persons, qualities, or garden products.

context_deltas.mechanism: The blessing refrain immediately brackets the focus and the closing blessing is stable and growing, converting attractive contents into acknowledged, durable gifts.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence and gift supply the focus category that the refrain asks recipients to recognize.
Good action makes the gift beneficial in operation, not merely decorative.
Blessings as gifts frame the focus contents as received favors.
Stable, growing good gives the focus gifts persistence and increase.

structural_cues: The repeated blessing challenge occurs at 55:69 and 55:71, placing 55:70 inside an acknowledgment frame.
The surah closes at 55:78 with a blessing formula after the garden catalogue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated blessings and stable growing good; I infer a donor-recipient relation around the focus plurals, while the alternative is that the refrain merely punctuates a literal catalogue.

changed_reading.before: The focus names attractive possessions available in the gardens.
changed_reading.after: It names beneficent gifts whose beauty includes durable usefulness and whose reception calls for acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The perish-remain contrast, continuing provision, and growing blessing shift khayrat from a finite stock of consumables toward renewed good sustained through time.

activation_trace.role: Beneficial desired good is the content placed under the temporal contrast.
Abundant giving lets the good be renewed rather than exhausted as inventory.
Cessation after prior continuance supplies the negative temporal pole.
Continuance and remaining supply the positive temporal pole.
Continuing provision turns garden flow into a model of ongoing supply.
Stable growth supplies the regenerative rather than merely static form of good.

structural_cues: The mortality contrast at 55:26-27 precedes the garden sequences.
Flowing and gushing waters repeatedly precede fruit and the focus clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, continuance, flow, and growing good; I infer that renewal is the way garden benefits resist exhaustion, without assigning independent permanence to the contents.

changed_reading.before: Khayrat is a fixed pile of desirable garden contents.
changed_reading.after: Khayrat can be a renewable economy of good, beautiful because provision keeps arriving rather than being depleted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The judgment scene makes character legible through marks, and a non-dominant mapped branch links beauty to a visible trace; this lets hisan function as the outward evidence of inward khayr.

activation_trace.role: Virtue and marked excellence supply the inward quality that can become visible.
Manifest beauty supplies the outward face of the focus excellence.
Recognition through an effect or sign supplies the legibility mechanism.
Beauty bearing a visible trace makes appearance evidence rather than an unrelated embellishment.

structural_cues: At 55:41 culpable identity is immediately recognizable by visible signs.
The focus places excellence before beauty, allowing the adjective to disclose the noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition by signs and a split-root branch where beauty leaves an effect; I infer an inward-to-outward arrow, while the live alternative is ordinary physical attractiveness with no evidentiary role.

changed_reading.before: Goodness and beauty are two adjacent compliments.
changed_reading.after: Beauty may be the readable surface of excellence, so the two words describe an inside-to-outside moral morphology.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branching growth, continuing water, dense dark vegetation, gushing springs, and fruit form a production chain whose beautiful beneficial yields can be the focus plurals.

activation_trace.role: Desired benefit supplies the usable yield of the ecological chain.
Pleasing beauty qualifies the chain's products and conditions.
Extending, branching boughs supply differentiated growth.
Continuous provision makes flowing water the enabling input.
Dark saturation supplies the visual density of mature vegetation.
Abundant erupting water intensifies the productive input.
Pleasant fruit supplies the concrete output immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: The second garden pair runs from dense greenness through gushing springs and named fruits directly into 55:70.
Repeated dual interiors broaden to the plural interior pronoun in the focus, allowing a summary across the garden set.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water, branching, dense growth, and fruit; I infer a causal ecology and take the focus as a summary of its yields, while the following companion description keeps a personal reading alive.

changed_reading.before: The clause introduces only a new class of beautiful inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: It can summarize the gardens' beneficial, aesthetically complete yields before the discourse narrows again to companions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Three surrounding roots independently expose branches of choice or select essence, activating the focus root's own selection branch as a cross-root refinement process.

activation_trace.role: Choosing the better option supplies the focus mechanism of selection.
The utmost limit supplies the degree reached by repeated refinement.
Preference for the choicest harvest supplies selection at the point of gathering.
The select essence of a thing turns the spring image into a cue of concentrated quality.
Selecting the best supplies a final refinement cue immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: Harvest, springs, palms, and the focus noun occur within the same garden catalogue.
The packet exposes convergent selection branches under different surface words rather than repeating the focus root.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three independent choice branches; I infer a refinement arrow from garden abundance to selected specimens, while the ordinary literal readings of harvest, springs, and palms remain primary at their own verses.

changed_reading.before: Khayrat means whatever happens to be good among abundant contents.
changed_reading.after: Khayrat can mean selected concentrations of the best, whether choice harvests, qualities, or beings brought to an utmost degree.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit correspondence of action and recompense at 55:60 turns the focus goodness into a response relation: beneficence is answered by beneficence and embodied in what is found within.

activation_trace.role: Generous gift supplies the returned benefit.
Beneficent action lets the adjective retain an ethical and active force.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the directional return.
Good action at both ends of the exchange identifies the currency of reciprocity.

structural_cues: The reciprocity question at 55:60 stands between the two garden pairs and before the focus recurrence of the same root.
The focus contains no explicit agent, leaving persons, deeds, qualities, and rewards able to coexist.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action and matching recompense; I infer that the later hisan can embody the returned good, while the alternative is that 55:60 and 55:70 use the same root independently in ethical and aesthetic senses.

changed_reading.before: Hisan only describes how the garden contents look.
changed_reading.after: Hisan can describe the ethical form of recompense, making the beautiful excellences an enacted answer to prior beneficence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sheaths, screened gardens, hidden linings, confinement, and tents repeat a container-interior relation; fihinna then locates excellence as preserved inner value rather than public display.

activation_trace.role: Choice excellence supplies the valuable content held inside the repeated containers.
Beauty supplies a value that need not depend on exposure to public view.
A plant vessel enclosing fruit supplies the earliest protected-content image.
An orchard screened by trees makes the garden itself an enclosure.
A hidden interior makes unseen lining a model for inward worth.
Confinement or restriction supplies deliberate boundedness.
Tent and settled residence supply the final containing space.

structural_cues: Locative interiors recur from fruit sheaths and gardens to linings and tents.
The focus begins with an interior pronoun before naming what is held there.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nested enclosures and hidden contents; I infer preservation as their shared function, while the alternative is a sequence of unrelated literal containers.

changed_reading.before: The focus displays beautiful goods for immediate inspection.
changed_reading.after: It locates choice beauty as protected interior value, applicable to fruit, qualities, furnishings, or companions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following feminine plurals name bright-eyed beings, restriction, and tented residence, making them a plausible specification of the focus's choice beautiful bearers.

activation_trace.role: Virtuous chosen persons supply the personal reading of the focus noun.
Personal beauty supplies the matching adjective for those persons.
Marked eye contrast supplies an explicitly person-like visual class.
Restriction to a bounded place supplies their protected condition.
Tented residence supplies the location in which the class is specified.

structural_cues: After the refrain at 55:71, 55:72 continues with feminine plural beings and locations.
The branchless ط م ث occurrence at 55:74 repeats the untouched-person structure of 55:56 and is used only as a structural cue.
The following noun phrase may be appositional specification or a new catalogue item.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a following feminine personal class, bounded residence, and a repeated untouched-person structure; I infer specification of 55:70, while a new independent item after the refrain remains materially possible.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful female beings are only one focus-only possibility.
changed_reading.after: The following sequence strongly activates excellent beautiful companions, but does not erase the focus clause's parallel goods, qualities, and beneficences.

context_deltas.mechanism: Furnishings and rare patterned textiles culminate in a nonhuman recurrence of hisan, so context both strengthens a personal reading and blocks its exclusivity.

activation_trace.role: Choice excellence remains applicable to persons or things and keeps the referent open.
Physical place and body uses keep the focus adjective from being person-exclusive.
Spread furnishings supply an earlier material object of garden praise.
A hanging or sheltering textile edge supplies the material frame of the later adjective.
Rare patterned carpets supply an explicitly crafted bearer of beauty.
The same beauty root applied in a physical setting demonstrates nonhuman adjectival range.

structural_cues: The exact focus adjective recurs at 55:76 beside green coverings and rare carpets.
Garden descriptions alternate persons, plants, water, fruit, and furnishings rather than maintaining one referent class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later material bearer of the same adjective; I infer that person-only exclusivity is weakened, while the alternative is that the recurrence is ordinary polysemy with no effect on the earlier noun.

changed_reading.before: The following companion verse settles khayrat hisan as exclusively personal.
changed_reading.after: The personal reading remains strong, but hisan demonstrably spans crafted and bodily beauty, preserving excellent things and qualities as coexisting referents.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus branch is an idiom about coaxing an animal from a burrow and is too distant to serve as a direct gloss; it remains anchored because the same focus root meets contextual emergence, open passage, concealment, and confinement. Render only as an 'as if' mechanism of latent good disclosed from bounded interiors, never as zoological content.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The unusual خ ي ر branch attaches directly to the focus noun and changes the force of the preceding locative interior.

activation_trace.role: Coaxing a hidden creature through another opening supplies the strange managed-disclosure mechanism.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies successful disclosure.
An unobstructed passage supplies the alternate outlet.
Concealment supplies the latent interior from which good can emerge.
Confinement supplies the boundary that makes managed emergence intelligible.

changed_reading.before: Good contents are simply stationary inside the gardens.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the clause can picture latent excellence disclosed through a governed passage from concealment rather than lying passively on display.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The utmost-effort idiom under ح س ن is form-distant, but it is focus-rooted and converges with totality and rare astonishing excellence nearby. Carry it as an intensity reading, not as a claim that hisan lexically means superlative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes choosing the better with a ح س ن branch of reaching one's limit.

activation_trace.role: Selection of the better supplies refinement toward a top choice.
Utmost effort or limit supplies the surprising intensity ceiling.
Encompassing totality supplies completeness of the available range.
Rare, astonishing elevation supplies contextual pressure toward exceptional degree.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, hisan marks selected excellence carried to its limit, an intensive culmination rather than a mild compliment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The physical-name branch of ح س ن and the eye/interior/bough network permit a body-landscape homology, but no single construction states it. Preserve it as a cross-domain image in which the setting itself becomes a beautiful living body, not as a lexical identification of gardens with persons.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus adjective has a branch spanning places and bodies, while fihinna makes interiority grammatically salient.

activation_trace.role: Names of beautiful places and bodies license the cross-domain hinge at the focus adjective.
Extending boughs supply limb-like articulation to the setting.
The seeing eye supplies the bodily side of the spring-eye pivot.
A flowing water source supplies the landscape side of the same pivot.
Belly or inner side supplies an anatomical image for the garden's concealed interior.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful beings or objects occupy an inert garden setting.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the garden itself becomes a beautiful living body with branching limbs, flowing eyes, and a beneficial interior.

strongest_changes: Khayrat hisan shifted from a generic inventory to cultivated, proportioned excellence.
The water-growth-fruit sequence kept an ecological yield reading alive beside the companion reading.
The reciprocity verse activated ethical action and recompense inside language that can otherwise sound merely aesthetic.
The later material use of hisan prevented the following companion description from closing down all nonpersonal readings.
Convergent choice branches turned garden abundance into selected or concentrated excellence.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained productively unstable across persons, gifts, actions, ecological yields, protected interiors, and crafted things. Especially diagnostic were the non-dominant visible-mark activation, the cross-root selection chain, and the way later context both specified companions and reopened material beauty.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether khayrat primarily denotes persons, deeds, goods, qualities, or deliberate polyvalence remains unresolved.
The scope of fihinna across the garden plurality and any nearer feminine antecedents remains structurally open.
The relation of 55:72 to 55:70 may be specification across a refrain or a new catalogue item.
Selection, managed emergence, and garden-body models are activations from branch convergence, not secure lexical glosses.
